recipes.name: Task → alternative → value → proof
checks: Every differentiator connects an actual alternative to a relevant value
The proof demonstrates the mechanism rather than repeating the promise
limitations: Professional framework, not a performance guarantee

recipes.name: Coherent, signaled product demonstration
checks: Narration and visual proof are temporally aligned
Decoration does not compete with the product action
Duration is measured for the actual audience and channel
limitations: Instructional-video evidence may not transfer directly to marketing outcomes

recipes.name: Accessible motion and synchronized captions
checks: No essential information is conveyed only through animation
Qualifying motion can be reduced, paused, stopped or hidden
Captions include speech and relevant audio and are terminology-reviewed
limitations: Apply exact WCAG criterion scope and conformance level

recipes.name: Hypothesis → publish → measure → refresh
checks: Hypothesis is distinct from observed outcome
Null and inconclusive results remain visible
Publication and changes retain rationale and reviewer history
limitations: Small samples may not support causal conclusions
Platform retention does not equal conversion
